basic_info.main_problem: 我经常仓促下结论并将情境个人化,导致总觉得自己是个糟糕的孙子.这些感受从几个月前爷爷某一天have not带我去吃冰淇淋开始出现.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings are affecting my relationships with my family and causing me distress.
growth_experiences: 几个月前,爷爷有一天have not带我去吃冰淇淋,这一事件显著trigger了我对家庭互动的过度个人化与'读心术'式推断.起初压力水平not高,但这种倾向逐步加剧,发展为经常假设家人对我抱有负面意图并Persistent guilt;当家人出现任何'轻微冒犯'或Silence时,这些感受都会被激活,并进一步影响到我的学业表现与日常兴趣(如打篮球).

special_situations.event: 爷爷那天have not带我去吃冰淇淋
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果长辈have not按计划与我共度时间,必然是我做错了或让他们not高兴
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Blames himself and tries to communicate with his grandmother to confirm whether it is his problem
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He must be angry with me; I must have done something wrong; I am a bad grandson

special_situations.event: Grandmother being quieter than usual at a dinner
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If family members are quieter than usual, it means I have annoyed them
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not去核查事实,反复自我检视与内疚
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我一定让她not高兴;It is all my fault

special_situations.event: 当家人出现轻微的冷淡或与Anticipationnot一致的行为
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If any slight rudeness or change occurs, the root cause must be with me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Quickly blames oneself and falls into guilt to try to maintain the relationship and avoid conflict
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am a burden; they probably hate being with me

special_situations.event: When studying or doing daily activities (such as playing basketball), recalls 'minor offenses' in the family
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能让家人满意,我就not配享受或专注于自己的活动
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 以Persistent self-criticism和内疚来约束自己,减少享乐活动
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not配享受;I disappointed my family

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be liked and accepted by family and to be close to them
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被家人拒绝或责备,担心自己是负担,not被爱
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of security in the relationship through self-blame and guilt, avoiding the rejection or conflict that direct inquiry might bring

object_relations.self_representation: A burden / terrible grandson, someone who easily disappoints others
object_relations.object_representation: Judgers / rejecters (grandparents) who are easily annoyed by me
